name.en-US: The Cost of a Crown: A Story of Douay and Durham
name.pt-BR: O Preço de uma Coroa: História de Douai e Durham

description.en-US: Benson's sacred drama of 1910, written for the boys of St Edmund's College, Ware, about the martyrs of the English College at Douai and the persecution in Durham: a prologue and three acts.
description.pt-BR: O drama sacro de Benson (1910), escrito para os alunos do St Edmund's College, Ware, sobre os mártires do Colégio Inglês de Douai e a perseguição em Durham: um prólogo e três atos.

sources.edition: The Cost of a Crown: A Story of Douay and Durham (London: Longmans, Green, 1910), Internet Archive full-text OCR (cu31924013587989).
sources.description: Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Mgr. Robert Hugh Benson died in 1914 and the edition is of 1910, so the text is public domain.
